stumbles.quote: Lock screen rotation in portrait before you start. The game asks for landscape itself, with a prompt to turn the phone, and an unlocked screen would rotate on its own.
stumbles.why: Confusing: if rotation is locked in portrait, turning the phone to landscape won't rotate the screen, yet the game wants landscape. It's unclear why the lock is needed, or whether the game still works in landscape with the lock on. The reason given (an unlocked screen would rotate on its own) seems to argue against the game's own landscape request.

stumbles.quote: The first screen is held in portrait
stumbles.why: Unclear whether this means the player should hold the phone in portrait, or the game forces portrait layout. It sits awkwardly beside the landscape instruction.

stumbles.quote: The game zeroes steering to the phone's tilt at the moment the start lights go out
stumbles.why: Doesn't say what 'zeroes' means in practice (calibrates neutral to the current angle), and the start lights haven't been introduced. It's unclear when they appear or how the player is meant to know when to hold steady.

stumbles.quote: Tilt the top of the phone away from you to accelerate and towards you to brake.
stumbles.why: In landscape, 'top of the phone' is ambiguous (the side edge that is now up?). It's also unclear whether acceleration is relative to the zeroed angle, and whether steering left and right means rolling the phone like a steering wheel.

stumbles.quote: Three tracks ship: Fjord, Quarry and Ring.
stumbles.why: 'Ship' is jargon, and the text never says how to choose track, laps and difficulty or what the difficulty options are. It also doesn't say what 'Ring' refers to. This is minor.

point: Open the URL on a motion-sensor phone, lock portrait rotation, pick track, laps and difficulty, turn the phone to landscape when prompted, hold it in your driving pose as the lights go out, then tilt to steer, accelerate and brake.
